style.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal studio backdrop #1F2126 for hero and claim screens, pure white #FFFFFF info sections, brushed light-silver rounded panels #E9EAEC

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dark premium kitchen-appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal backdrop #1F2126, pure white info sections #FFFFFF, brushed light-silver panels #E9EAEC, one red accent #D8342B and one amber data accent #F5A623 reserved for oversized numerals; controlled studio lighting with a soft upper-right rim and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headline type with a thin red accent rule #D8342B; consistent thin-line icons on circular silver discs and rounded chip labels; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight front 3/4 hero product angle and scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: product stable on a low round podium with a recurring slight front 3/4 hero angle and consistent scale; cooked food rendered generic (golden crispy drumsticks or fries), never replicating the source plating; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
style.surfaceSystem: matte charcoal round podium #2A2C31, clean white studio floor, muted grey matte card surfaces #D9DBDE
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, bold short headline type in #FFFFFF on dark and #1F2126 on white with a thin red accent rule #D8342B, amber #F5A623 reserved for oversized data numerals, no decorative fonts
